categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determination for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels, their locations, ownership (all listed as "The State"), and registration particulars. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements administered by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement.
